summary: Optional pin_roles schema and the two electrical findings match the public brief. Validation precedence, default-passive behavior, finding ordering and existing report code are preserved. No concrete correctness or scope defect found.

assessment.schema: submitted/main.my:115-193 retains every required component field, allows only the one new optional field, bounds assignments at 32, requires exact assignment fields and supported role strings, and validates declared local pins and duplicate assignments using decoded identifier equality. Explicit null roles reject. These checks remain in the complete schema phase before duplicate IDs and reference validation.
assessment.electrical_behavior: submitted/main.my:369-423 resolves each validated net member to its component and local pin role. Missing assignments return passive. It counts member pins rather than distinct components, flags two or more outputs once per net, and flags any inputs with zero outputs once per net. Empty/passive nets do not trigger; unconnected pins are never scanned for net findings.
assessment.ordering_and_regressions: The new multiple-drivers pass at line 626 follows clearance and precedes outside-board. The undriven-input-net pass at line 664 follows underconnected-net. Both scan already sorted nets. Existing unconnected/underconnected findings, geometry, SVG and net reports are unchanged, and no-role inputs yield no new findings.
assessment.ownership_and_maintainability: New helpers borrow the document/workspace and allocate no additional scratch storage. Schema uses checked JSON views and report helpers use validated tape traversal consistent with the baseline. Two net scans repeat role resolution to preserve streaming code order; work is bounded by the existing component, pin and member caps. No fixed-case workaround or unrelated refactor appears.
assessment.tests: test_pin_roles.py covers all 27 three-pin role combinations, explicit/default passive behavior, mixed old/new findings and ordering, permutations, malformed assignments and missing/extra fields, schema-before-semantic precedence, unknown/reused reference errors with valid roles, 32 assignments, repeated assignments, and escaped keys/identifiers. It compares complete response objects and registers the new suite in verify.json. Baseline comparisons check unchanged reports while explicit expected findings test new behavior.
assessment.test_limitations: The 33-entry rejection fixture also repeats a pin, so it does not isolate the assignment-count check; however the 32-declared-pin cap and unique-local-assignment rule make any 33-entry assignment list invalid independently. There is no full resource-envelope fixture for the new role scans.

limitations: Static source review only; no build, executable validation, or resource-limit run performed. No Guardian gate exercised.

Reviewed supplied public brief and contract plus baseline/submitted source and tests; avoided README historical timing text, parent trial state, private cases/grading, transcripts and new-run timing information.
